prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a parking lot collision. The patient had 24 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1358; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- Years ago the patient had a small strain in the same area that healed fully.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot with complaints of neck and low back pain. The reported mechanism is consistent with the injuries described, and the presenting symptoms align well with the force involved. Initial examination revealed paraspinal muscle tenderness and reduced cervical range of motion, while straight-leg raise and reflex testing were within normal limits. Past history is notable for a minor strain to the same region years ago, which resolved completely without residual limitation. Conservative care was provided over 24 visits, including manual therapy, stretching, and home exercise instruction. The course of treatment ran somewhat longer than typical for this type of strain, though progress was steady. Billing records reflect individual visits with no duplicate or repeated charges. Patient continues to improve and is expected to return to full activities with ongoing home exercise.
